meta.description: Warren movers for a few pieces of furniture, downsizing or a small apartment. Hourly billing with a 2-hour minimum that includes travel time. Free quote.

overview: Not every Warren move fills a truck. Sometimes it's a sofa, a dresser and a bed frame going to a smaller place, and that's a job we take.
The crew takes apart what needs it, wraps each piece and puts it back together at the other end.

servicesBlock.h2: Furniture and Small Moves in Warren
servicesBlock.intro: Furniture-only jobs and downsizing moves are what this page covers. If the job grows, the same crew can add packing, a full residential move or storage for pieces that won't fit the new place. The service list below has the details on each one.

whyChoose.h2: Why Warren Downsizers Book a Small Crew With Us

cards.title: Sized to the Job
cards.text: The manager asks what is moving and sends a crew to match: two movers for a few pieces, more for a full home.

cards.title: Taken Apart, Put Back
cards.text: Bed frames, tables and desks are taken apart where needed, with the hardware bagged together so no screw goes missing.

cards.title: Pieces You're Not Keeping
cards.text: Downsizing often leaves furniture with nowhere to go. We can hold it while you decide, and storage is priced by the cubic feet your items take up.

cards.title: Billing for Small Moves
cards.text: Local moves are billed hourly, with travel time from our yard added. A short furniture run still has a 2-hour minimum that includes travel time.

faq.q: Will you come to Warren for just two or three pieces of furniture?
faq.a: Yes. Small furniture moves are welcome, and they're billed with a 2-hour minimum that includes travel time.

faq.q: Do your movers take apart beds and tables?
faq.a: Yes. The crew disassembles anything that won't fit through doors or stairways in one piece and rebuilds it in the new room.

faq.q: How do you protect a single antique or heirloom piece?
faq.a: It's wrapped in blankets and shrink wrap, then strapped in the truck. For very fragile pieces, ask about white glove handling when you book.

faq.q: We're moving to a smaller home in Warren. Where should the extra furniture go?
faq.a: Storage is one option while you decide. The crew can split the load, delivering some pieces to the new home and taking the rest to storage.

faq.q: Can you shift furniture between floors of the same building?
faq.a: Often, and without a truck at all. Whether it works depends on the items and the building, so describe the job when you ask for a quote.

faqClosing: Have a different small-job question? Check our FAQ page or ask the manager when you request a quote.

closing.body: List the pieces, the floors and both addresses. We'll tell you how many movers it takes and roughly how long it should run.
